detection._doc: Every active vendor program is installed from a reviewed platform artifact, under one bootstrap-owned program prefix. Configuration remains owned by the setup system and account state by the user.

grok-build.rationale: Verified archive and full payload receipt; configuration and credentials are preserved.

devin.rationale: Verified official Devin CLI archive and full payload receipt; configuration and credentials are preserved.

herdr.summary: Terminal workspace manager for AI coding agents (tmux-style multiplexer with agent session support).
herdr.update_policy: pinned-bootstrap-managed; never invoke mutable herdr update during install or verify

telegram.summary: Telegram Desktop messenger from the official telegramdesktop/tdesktop GitHub release.

doctl.summary: DigitalOcean command-line interface from the official digitalocean/doctl GitHub release.

stripe.summary: Stripe CLI from the official stripe/stripe-cli GitHub release.

gcloud.summary: Google Cloud SDK CLI (gcloud, gsutil, bq) from the versioned cloud-sdk-release archive.
gcloud.update_policy: pinned-bootstrap-managed; never invoke gcloud components update

resend.summary: Resend CLI from the npm resend-cli package, installed through pinned Bun global.

wrangler.summary: Cloudflare Wrangler CLI from the npm wrangler package, installed through pinned Bun global.

ubuntu_apt_packages._doc: Packages for terminal, source analysis, LSP hosts, and profile-specific build support.

terminal_tools._doc: Interactive terminal tools the shell template binds aliases and abbreviations to. `shared` is published on both platforms, under the command name given; `macos_only` is deliberately not on Ubuntu. A guard in templates/terminal/zshrc for a command outside this block is a no-op and tests/test_terminal_portability.py rejects it.

macos_only.duckdb: Analytical SQL engine; no interactive alias binds it and no Ubuntu profile needs an embedded OLAP database.
macos_only.jnv: Interactive jq explorer; jaq covers the scripted path on both platforms.
macos_only.xh: HTTP client; Ubuntu installs httpie from apt for the same role.
macos_only.yazi: TUI file manager; no alias binds it, and its Ubuntu build needs a newer toolchain than the supported releases carry.

macos_package_determinism._doc: The determinism class of every package this adapter installs on macOS. ADR 0010 records the decision and why. A package in BREW_SOURCE_PACKAGES or GUI_CASKS with no class here fails tests/test_contract_parity.py, and provenance metadata may only claim what its class can support.

classes.immutable-upstream-artifact: Exact URL and digest tracked in this repository; Homebrew is not the source.
classes.rolling-homebrew-formula: Whatever homebrew/core currently serves. An already installed keg is preserved, so two Macs may carry different patch versions of one release. A version floor is the enforced property, not an exact version.
classes.rolling-homebrew-cask: Whatever the cask currently serves, on the same terms as a rolling formula.
classes.registry-pinned: Exact version from a package registry, integrity from that registry's own transparency or digest contract.

provenance_must_not_declare.formula_revision: describes a build this repository does not control or pin
provenance_must_not_declare.bottle_tag: describes a build this repository does not control or pin
provenance_must_not_declare.bottle_sha256: cannot be re-derived from an installed keg
provenance_must_not_declare.executable_sha256: not a pin under a rolling class: it changes whenever homebrew-core rebuilds, so freezing it turns a normal upstream event into a red required check
